headerDisplay: Exposes Shelly devices to Apple Home over Matter, including live power and energy metering (iOS 27+). Requires Homebridge v2.2.0+ with Matter enabled on the bridge.

mdnsDiscover.title: Discover devices via mDNS
mdnsDiscover.description: Automatically discover Shelly devices on the local network.

rpcOverUdp.title: RPC over UDP (Gen 2+)
rpcOverUdp.description: Listen on UDP port 8585 for device updates. Devices you configure for it (device settings > RPC over UDP > destination <homebridge-ip>:8585, listening port 8585) then report over UDP instead of a WebSocket; the simplest way to get updates from Gen 2+ battery devices. Off by default.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Per-device configuration. Discovered devices appear in the table above; add a device manually only when mDNS cannot find it (set its IP address). By default plugs are shown as outlets and other devices as lights, with power metering enabled where available.

host.title: IP address or hostname, optionally with a port as ip:port (e.g. behind a Shelly Range Extender). Filled automatically for discovered devices; lets the plugin work without mDNS.

name.title: Name shown in the Home app

accessoryType.title: Accessory type (empty = default: outlet for plugs, light otherwise)

vibrationAsMotion.title: Vibration as motion sensor (Door/Window sensors)
vibrationAsMotion.description: Expose the sensor's vibration (impact) detection as a motion sensor: an impact shows as motion for 10 seconds. Matter has no vibration sensor type, so Apple Home shows it as motion. Off by default. The detection itself is a device setting: enable vibration and raise "Vibration sensitivity" in the Shelly app (the factory default of 50 is often too low; 100 works).

gasAlarm.title: Gas alarm shown as (Shelly Gas)
gasAlarm.description: Matter has no gas detector type. Expose the Shelly Gas alarm as a smoke alarm or a carbon monoxide alarm in Apple Home (mild gas = warning, heavy gas = critical). Off by default; the ppm value is not shown.

splitChannels.title: Split channels into separate accessories
splitChannels.description: Multi-channel devices only, on by default: each channel becomes its own accessory that can be assigned to its own room. Turn off to expose the device as one grouped accessory. Changing this re-creates the device's accessories - reassign rooms after.

channels.title: Channels (multi-channel devices only)
channels.description: Per-channel settings; channels without an entry use the device settings. Channel numbers are 0-based, as on the device.

condition.functionBody: try { const c = model.devices[arrayIndices[0]].channels; return Array.isArray(c) && c.length > 1; } catch (e) { return false; }

name.title: Name (only used in the Home app when channels are split into separate accessories)

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for password-protected Gen 1 devices. Gen 2+ devices always use 'admin'.

interfaceName.title: Network interface
interfaceName.description: Optional network interface to use for mDNS discovery (e.g. eth0).
